learning_outcomes.text: Name theoretically and practically usable potentials of renewable energies and explain the difference.
Describe technical possibilities for utilizing the potentials.
Calculate the usable potentials according to the current state of the art.
Select suitable systems for regenerative energy generation for a given location and make yield forecasts.
Present facts from the field of energy technology, draw own conclusions and defend them in discussion.

syllabus_topics: Efficiency and energy return on investment (EROI)
Technical possibilities for using wind, sun, water, biomass, ocean currents
assessment_rules: The prerequisite for receiving credit points is a passed module examination. The grade is weighted by credit points.
bibliography: Wesselak et al.: Handbuch Regenerative Energietechnik, 3. Auflage, Springer Vieweg, Berlin 2017

Kaltschmitt et al.: Erneuerbare Energien, 6. Auflage, Springer Vieweg, Berlin 2020
